name: Microsoft Clarity
description: Microsoft Clarity is a behavioral analytics service for understanding website traffic, engagement, and user-experience friction.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user-owned project Data Export API token. Relay exposes one bounded read-only wrapper for the previous one to three days of project-live-insight metrics with at most three supported dimensions; session recordings, heatmaps, instrumentation, custom identifiers and events, project administration, and raw provider access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: microsoft_clarity_api_token
credentialRequirements.label: Data Export API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated token under the Clarity project's Settings → Data Export page. Relay stores only a secret-store reference.

credentialRequirements.name: microsoft_clarity_project_label
credentialRequirements.label: Project or site label
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional non-secret label for the connected Clarity project.

credentialRequirements.name: microsoft_clarity_project_url
credentialRequirements.label: Project or site URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional non-secret site URL that identifies the connected project.

capabilities.label: Clarity Data Export API
capabilities.description: Use the fixed project-live-insights Data Export endpoint.

capabilities.label: Project live insights
capabilities.description: Read bounded recent project metrics for one to three days and up to three supported dimensions.

allowed.label: Get project live insights
allowed.description: Read the previous one to three days of Clarity project-live-insight metrics with up to three supported dimensions.

blocked.label: Export raw session recordings
blocked.description: Raw session recordings are not exposed by the read-only V1 wrapper.

blocked.label: Export heatmaps
blocked.description: Heatmap assets and broad exports are not exposed by the V1 wrapper.

blocked.label: Change instrumentation
blocked.description: Tracking scripts, masking, tags, custom events, and custom identifiers cannot be changed.

blocked.label: Administer project
blocked.description: Project, user, settings, and API-token administration is blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded recent-insights read runs automatically while exports, instrumentation, and administration remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same read-only wrapper runs while endpoint, date-window, dimension, row, redaction, quota, and audit guards remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded Clarity Data Export wrapper and injects the project token from encrypted storage.
Relay mounts one bounded Clarity Data Export wrapper and injects the project token from encrypted storage.

providerSetup.nextAction: A project admin generates a dedicated Data Export API token, stores it in Relay, and replaces it in Clarity when rotation or revocation is required.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents project-admin token generation, Bearer authentication, the fixed project-live-insights endpoint, one-to-three-day windows, up to three dimensions, a 1,000-row non-paginated response, and ten requests per project per day.
Microsoft documents the separate client instrumentation surface for identifiers, tags, events, masking, and recording behavior; Relay intentionally does not expose that surface.
